references.text: This text describes the original event where the people buried those who had craved food, and the place was called Kibroth-hattaavah (graves of craving). Then they traveled to Hazeroth.
Describes the departure from Hazeroth to the Wilderness of Paran, confirming the stay in Hazeroth mentioned in Numbers 33:17.
Mentions Kibroth-hattaavah as one of the places where the people of Israel provoked the Lord to anger and confirms the site's significance during the wilderness journey.
